g.title: cluster_server
g.text: HOME SERVER (Threadripper 48 threads, 251 GB RAM, GTX 1080 8 GB)

g.title: cam1
g.text: check every 150 ms: motion, sharpness, light

g.title: shot
g.text: Take the photo when the phone is steady
keep the sharpest frame, +1–2 extra frames

g.title: cam2
g.text: one book, or many books in a row

g.title: mnet
g.text: 'is a book filling the view?' 'are all 4 corners in view?'
file 4.1 MB + 9.6 MB runtime · ~30–60 MB RAM (est.)

g.title: box
g.text: store and forward, retries 15 s → 15 min
sent even with the app closed

g.title: fast
g.text: Look up the ISBN at once

g.title: sess
g.text: wait for the end of the session
(5 s after the last photo, up to 3 min)

g.title: worker
g.text: B6 Scan worker: one scan at a time

g.title: sort
g.text: pair front + back covers, group shelf photos

g.title: later
g.text: Background, when the GPU is idle (section 5)
web-search queue, cover text, genres, sharpening

g.title: human
g.text: A PERSON approves, corrects or declines
